Title: Service-aided subnet configuration for managed instance in Azure SQL Database is now in preview

Body.Content:
To address customer security and manageability requirements, managed instance, a deployment capability of Azure SQL Database, is transitioning from a manual to service-aided subnet configuration (in preview).

With the service-aided subnet configuration, you control data traffic while managed instance ensures uninterrupted flow of management traffic. The configuration also enables improved network security policy.

The preview is available in the East US and West US regions.

Learn more about the service-aided subnet configuration.
